figures.finding: The British Indian Ocean Territory has no writers' agreement, guild or fund: it is a British Overseas Territory administered from London, entry needs a permit, and its roughly 2,000 people are military personnel, officials and contractors at the Diego Garcia base.
figures.applies: British Indian Ocean Territory (IO), as of 2026-11-01; no film or television industry.

sources.said: is a British Overseas Territory. It is administered from London and is located approximately halfway between East Africa and Indonesia. Access is restricted and a permit is required in advance of travel.

Diego Garcia, the largest of the islands, makes up 44 square kilometres of that, and hosts a strategically important joint UK/US military facility. There are ordinarily around 2000 people on Diego Garcia. They are mostly a mix of UK and US military personnel, BIOTA officials and civilian contractors responsible for the maintenance and operation of the military facility.
